pages.title: Harvest Market
pages.concept: A welcoming illustrated title cover centred on an abundant market crate.
pages.artwork_description: A framed hand-lettered header reads “HARVEST MARKET” with the smaller subtitle “Autumn Colouring Pages”. Beneath it, a symmetrical wooden crate overflows with apples, pears, small squash, beetroot, carrots and tied herb bundles. Curving oak leaves, acorns and small berry sprigs create an airy border.
pages.generation_prompt: Colouring-book cover with exact header text “HARVEST MARKET” and smaller subtitle “Autumn Colouring Pages”; centred rustic wooden market crate overflowing with apples, pears, small squash, beetroot, carrots and tied herb bundles; symmetrical stable display; airy border of oak leaves, acorns, berry sprigs and small produce motifs; leave the title lettering clear, legible and spacious.
pages.production_notes: Verify all cover text exactly: “HARVEST MARKET” and “Autumn Colouring Pages”. Keep the crate and each item fully enclosed for optional colouring; do not use logos, labels or Halloween motifs.

pages.title: Apple Crate Abundance
pages.concept: The signature overflowing apple crate market display.
pages.artwork_description: A large slatted wooden crate is piled high with 18 clearly distinct apples, with three pears, two small squash and two herb bundles tucked around it. Apple branches and scattered leaves form a restrained decorative frame; woodgrain and leaf veins add colourable texture.
pages.generation_prompt: Centred slatted wooden market crate overflowing with exactly 18 distinct apples; exactly three pears, two small squash and two tied herb bundles arranged around the crate; sparse apple branches and fallen leaves framing the display; open woodgrain on crate slats, simple apple stems and leaf-vein details; no wording.
pages.production_notes: Count check: 18 apples, 3 pears, 2 squash and 2 herb bundles. Ensure each apple remains visually separate rather than merging into an indistinct pile.

pages.title: Pumpkin and Squash Stall
pages.concept: An orderly seasonal squash display with decorative variety.
pages.artwork_description: A three-tier wooden market stand holds eight different pumpkins and squash: ribbed pumpkin, butternut squash, acorn squash, delicata squash, pattypan squash, spaghetti squash, kabocha squash and a small round gourd. Twining vine leaves and blossoms curl lightly around the stand.
pages.generation_prompt: Three-tier wooden market stand displaying exactly eight visibly different autumn pumpkins and squash: one ribbed pumpkin, one butternut squash, one acorn squash, one delicata squash, one pattypan squash, one spaghetti squash, one kabocha squash and one small round gourd; gentle curling vines, leaves and a few blossoms around the stand; each vegetable clearly separated; no wording.
pages.production_notes: Variety check: all 8 named squash types must have recognisably different silhouettes. Avoid an overcrowded stand and retain broad colourable sections on the vegetables.

pages.title: Orchard Harvest Basket
pages.concept: A woven basket of orchard fruit beneath a graceful apple branch.
pages.artwork_description: A round woven basket filled with apples, pears and plums sits on a simple checked cloth. Above it, an arching apple branch bears fruit and leaves. Two small baskets of fallen fruit and a few meadow stems create a balanced low-density setting.
pages.generation_prompt: Large round woven orchard basket filled with apples, pears and plums resting on a simple checked cloth; one arching apple tree branch overhead bearing fruit and leaves; two small side baskets of fallen fruit, a few meadow stems and scattered leaves; woven texture should be open and colourable; no wording.
pages.production_notes: Keep the checked cloth pattern broad and regular, not dense. Confirm the central basket remains the immediate focal object.

pages.title: Herb Market Bundles
pages.concept: An elegant apothecary-style arrangement of kitchen herbs.
pages.artwork_description: Five labelled-looking but blank paper-wrapped herb bundles—rosemary, sage, thyme, parsley and lavender—hang from a simple wooden rail. Small botanical sprigs, seed heads and a terracotta pot sit below; the paper tags are intentionally blank, without printed names.
pages.generation_prompt: Five distinct tied kitchen-herb bundles hanging from a simple wooden rail: rosemary, sage, thyme, parsley and lavender, each with a blank paper tag and visible characteristic leaf shapes; small terracotta pot, seed heads and botanical sprigs below; balanced vertical composition; no lettering on tags.
pages.production_notes: Use blank tags only to avoid illegible generated text. Ensure five distinct bundles and visually differentiable herb foliage; keep hanging strings and rail lines clean.

pages.title: Root Vegetable Barrow
pages.concept: A garden wheelbarrow brimming with freshly gathered roots.
pages.artwork_description: A vintage garden wheelbarrow holds carrots, beetroot, parsnips, turnips and leeks, each with leafy tops. A small hand trowel and gardening gloves rest nearby, while loose leaves and tiny seedheads form a quiet ground-level frame.
pages.generation_prompt: Vintage garden wheelbarrow full of carrots, beetroot, parsnips, turnips and leeks with leafy tops; small hand trowel and pair of gardening gloves placed beside the wheelbarrow; a few loose autumn leaves and delicate seedheads around the base; root vegetables clearly distinguishable and enclosed; no wording.
pages.production_notes: Avoid solid dark areas inside the wheelbarrow. Keep the wheel, handles and vegetable contours well separated for easy colouring.

pages.title: Late Harvest Table
pages.concept: A refined still life of seasonal food laid for market tasting.
pages.artwork_description: A rustic table holds a round loaf of bread, a small bowl of apples, a pitcher of dried wheat, a jar of honey with a dipper, two pears, a folded napkin and a cluster of grapes. A lightly patterned table runner anchors the composition, with a narrow leaf garland above.
pages.generation_prompt: Rustic harvest table still life: one round loaf of bread, one small bowl of apples, one pitcher holding dried wheat stems, one jar of honey with honey dipper, exactly two pears, folded napkin and one grape cluster; lightly patterned table runner; narrow leaf garland above; clear central arrangement; no wording.
pages.production_notes: Count check: exactly 2 pears. Honey jar must be unbranded and unlabelled. Keep the table runner pattern simple enough to colour.

pages.title: Sunflower Market Bucket
pages.concept: A bright flower-and-produce pairing for late autumn colour.
pages.artwork_description: A tall ribbed market bucket holds seven sunflower heads, five small asters and leafy stems. Beside it are three mini pumpkins and a shallow woven tray of seed pods. A few petals and leaves make a gentle oval frame around the composition.
pages.generation_prompt: Tall ribbed market bucket holding exactly seven sunflower heads, exactly five small aster flowers and leafy stems; exactly three mini pumpkins beside the bucket; shallow woven tray of seed pods; scattered petals and leaves forming a gentle oval frame; no wording.
pages.production_notes: Count check: 7 sunflowers, 5 asters, 3 mini pumpkins. Show every sunflower face as a simple floral centre, not a face or character; keep seed-head texture open.

pages.title: Cider Press Harvest
pages.concept: A traditional hand cider press surrounded by orchard fruit.
pages.artwork_description: A compact wooden hand cider press with a turning handle stands at centre, flanked by two open baskets of apples. A glass bottle and two plain tumblers sit in front, with apple branches and falling leaves creating a sparse arch overhead. No branding or written labels appear.
pages.generation_prompt: Compact traditional wooden hand cider press at centre with turning handle; two open baskets of apples, one on each side; plain glass bottle and exactly two unlabelled tumblers in front; apple branches and falling leaves forming a sparse arch overhead; no lettering, labels or branding.
pages.production_notes: Count check: exactly 2 tumblers. Make the cider press mechanically readable but not technical or cluttered; all bottle and glass outlines must be clear and closed.

pages.title: Mushroom and Woodland Basket
pages.concept: A restrained woodland-forage market basket without fantasy imagery.
pages.artwork_description: A low wicker basket contains assorted edible-looking mushrooms with varied caps, chestnuts and a folded linen cloth. Fern fronds, oak leaves, acorns and a few tiny mushrooms create a botanical frame. The scene is naturalistic and decorative, with no creatures, faces or magical elements.
pages.generation_prompt: Low wicker forage basket containing assorted mushrooms with varied cap shapes, chestnuts and folded linen cloth; surrounding fern fronds, oak leaves, acorns and a few small mushrooms create a light botanical frame; natural harvest-market still life, no creatures, faces, fantasy symbols or wording.
pages.production_notes: Do not depict toxic-identification claims or labels. Keep mushroom gills, caps and basket weave moderately detailed with broad colourable spaces.

pages.title: Cornucopia of Garden Bounty
pages.concept: A classic abundance arrangement with a calm, elegant profile.
pages.artwork_description: A woven cornucopia lies on its side and spills out apples, pears, grapes, corn, carrots, beetroot, leaves and small squash. Tall wheat stems rise behind the horn, while a simple repeating leaf-and-berry border occupies only the lower corners.
pages.generation_prompt: Woven cornucopia lying on its side, spilling apples, pears, grape clusters, corn cobs, carrots, beetroot, leaves and small squash; tall wheat stems rising behind the horn; restrained repeating leaf-and-berry motifs only in the two lower corners; graceful balanced abundance arrangement; no wording.
pages.production_notes: Ensure the horn opening and every food item have unambiguous enclosed outlines. Lower-corner border must not crowd the spilled produce.

pages.title: Harvest Market Stall
pages.concept: A grand closing market-stall scene with the full seasonal bounty.
pages.artwork_description: A symmetrical open-air market stall with a striped canopy displays produce in six wooden crates: apples, pears, pumpkins, carrots, beetroot and leafy greens. Herb bundles hang at each side, and a simple blank oval sign hangs beneath the canopy. Leaves and wheat sprigs frame the upper corners.
pages.generation_prompt: Symmetrical open-air autumn market stall with a simple striped canopy; six clearly separate wooden produce crates displaying, from left to right, apples, pears, pumpkins, carrots, beetroot and leafy greens; one tied herb bundle hanging on each side; blank oval sign beneath canopy; leaves and wheat sprigs framing upper corners; no text on the sign.
pages.production_notes: Final-page composition check: exactly 6 distinct crates in the stated left-to-right order, plus 2 hanging herb bundles. Keep the oval sign blank to avoid generated misspellings. Include no people, characters, Halloween imagery or branded signage.

selected_pages.reason: First illustration-led page (colouring): sets the core illustration style.
A different page type (colouring) tests a different layout and activity structure.
A later page (colouring, p12) checks the shared style stays consistent across the product.
